model.name: Lazy child resolve — structure eager, payload lazy, members by-reference
model.description: Transfer is STRUCTURE-eager / PAYLOAD-lazy: the primary unit + light metadata mint immediately (item appears instantly); file BYTES, deep subtrees, and member profiles resolve lazily on first need. Content dedups across servers by contentHash (skip the byte transfer + relink if the receiver already has it). Room MEMBERS stay federated identity references (ior@originHost), NEVER minted as local profiles — a foreign member only materializes locally on later connect+consolidate — so federation does NOT re-create the duplication R25.7 fixed.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (screenshots): dragging items between two RawBin servers (home.donges.it <-> prod.wo-da.de) must TRANSFER the scenario unit — the receiving server recreates it locally with all unitLinks — not just make a WebItem pointing at the source URL.
model.securityNote: Cross-cutting security/trust: capability grants are signed + expiring + scoped (no ambient authority); server-federation signatures use a per-server keypair + explicit trust list (no open fetch). Never trust incoming JSON blindly — validate schema, cap size, sanitize, NEVER execute; foreign identities NEVER become local auth principals.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Eager: the primary unit + light metadata are minted immediately so the item appears in the target room instantly.
Lazy: file BYTES fetch on first preview/open (via R26.3 /content); deep subtrees and member profiles resolve on demand.
Content dedups across servers by contentHash: on import, if the receiver already stores that hash, SKIP the byte transfer and just relink.

Room members transfer as federated identity references (ior:instance:<memberUuid>@originHost), NOT minted as local profiles; a foreign member materializes locally only on later connect+consolidate (ties to R25.7 redirectTo).
Federating a room NEVER mints foreign identities as local members — it must not re-create the duplication R25.7 eliminated.

model.crossRefNote: Ties to R25.7 room-dedup: foreign members stay federated references, NEVER minted as local profiles (would re-create the duplication R25.7 fixed).
